disorder-name.detail: Clinical cohort with autism spectrum disorder
disorder-name.supporting_text: The clinical sample comprised 202 individuals with ASD (100% male), 153 individuals with ADHD (41.18% male), 228 individuals with BP (47.37% male), 161 individuals with MDD (34.16% male), 167 individuals with OCD (50.30% male) and 383 individuals with SCZ (62.14% male).

dataset-of-origin.detail: Cases drawn from multiple studies and scan sites; disorder-specific datasets not enumerated in the main text.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: We examined data for 1,465 HCs (54.47% male) and 1,294 cases, taken from 14 different studies and 25 different scan sites.
